title: Capture draw calls and triangles after the world render, before any post pass
note: Read the whole frame's draw calls and triangles honestly, and share geometries and materials so the count stays low.
intent: renderer.info read after a post-processing pass reports the composite quad (1 call / 2 triangles), not the scene, because three resets the counters at the start of every render(). Capture drawCalls and triangles in the scene’s onAfterRender for the main camera — after the world pass, before the composer’s quad, and ignoring mirror or shadow pre-passes — and report those numbers from state()/probes(). Reuse geometries and materials across instances (a new material per object is the usual cause of a draw-call explosion), keep the visible triangle count in the low hundreds of thousands, and if fps in state() drops below ~50 fix that before adding anything else, because the judge notices stutter. The studio now counts draw calls and triangles itself, at the graphics API, and reports the whole frame under the reserved key __render in state(); the board reads __render.drawCalls and __render.triangles, so a project that reports nothing of its own is unmeasured rather than failed. Reporting your own fps, drawCalls and triangles from this capture is still worth it: it is what tells the builder which pass cost what.

check.note: The whole frame's honest figures from state().__render (counted at the graphics API, post pass included) stay under 1000 draw calls and 400k triangles; nothing countable is unmeasured, not failed.

port: Call attachStats(scene, camera) once in the mainOwner’s src/main.js after the scene exists and spread stats into state(); if the facet adds a mirror pass or an EffectComposer, keep the capture on the main camera’s world pass and never read renderer.info after composer.render().

evidence.note: renderer.info after a post pass reports the composite quad; capture right after the world render and report from probes()
reuse geometries/materials; a material per object is the draw-call explosion; triangles in the low hundreds of thousands; fix fps < ~50 first
